text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: EVAL-GATE ALERT: output-drift detector tripped for route /v1/chat (prod-us-east). Threshold breach: 0.23 -> 0.47 (window=5m). PagerDuty incident created: PD-INC-8472. Paging on-call.

pagerduty: PD-INC-8472 assigned to ryan_oncall (primary). Escalation timer set to 7m.

ryan_oncall: ack'd PD-INC-8472 :white_check_mark: seeing the page, joining. Quick summary?

incident-bot: Root cause hint: high semantic divergence on recent rollout (model=redwood-open-7b-quant-v2 -> variant=redwood-open-7b-quant-v3). Eval set "safety_prompt_suite_v2" shows safety regression score jump 0.02 -> 0.18.

anya_ml: @ryan_oncall thanks — i'm pulling eval logs now. If it's the v3 rollout, we saw increased hallucination on the finance prompt buckets earlier today.

ryan_oncall: timeline: rollout started 1766598000, ~3% traffic, autoscale OK. Alerts started at 1766604310. Customer-reported errors? liz_support any tickets?

liz_support: got 2 inbound CS tickets referencing "weird/confidently-wrong answers" on invoice parsing flow. Customers: AcmePay (high priority), Niftly. Logged in Zendesk: #2459, #2461. Posting short excerpt from AcmePay: "the model asserted a wrong tax rate and refused to correct".

james_ops: :eyes: traffic/latency stable, no infra OOMs. Suggest immediate mitigation: throttle rollout (stop ramp), switch route to fallback model variant (redwood-open-7b-quant-v1-safe), and enable prefix caching for known prompts.

anya_ml: agree with James. i'm going to run a quick eval diff and produce a recommended rollback if metrics back it. Running: `python infra/eval/diff.py --from v2 --to v3 --suite safety_prompt_suite_v2 --window 1h`

incident-bot: Command started: eval diff job ID eval-9821. ETA ~90s.

ryan_oncall: Taking action now: halting rollout (rdctl deploy pause --model redwood-open-7b-quant-v3 --route /v1/chat) and switching traffic to fallback: `rdctl route update /v1/chat --model redwood-open-7b-quant-v1-safe --weight 100` — applying.

pagerduty: PD-INC-8472 acknowledged by ryan_oncall at 1766604332.

anya_ml: eval diff finished: safety regression rate increased from 2.1% -> 18.3% on safety_prompt_suite_v2, and factual-consistency dropped by 14 points. Full output linked: https://evals.internal/redwood/eval-9821 (restricted). Recommendation: rollback to v1-safe for all customer-facing routes; hold v3 until root cause triage (tokenization change + new temperature default?).

ryan_oncall: rollback issued: rdctl deploy rollback --to redwood-open-7b-quant-v1-safe --route /v1/chat (command returned 202). Observed rollbacks begin at 1766604388.

liz_support: telling AcmePay/Affected customers we saw a quality regression, mitigation underway (traffic moved to safe model). Draft msg: "We detected a model regression and switched your requests to a stable variant; we will follow up with the root cause and remediation timeline." Want approval before sending.

oliver_csm: please send, include that we prioritized available mitigation and offer case escalation. I'll coordinate follow-up call with AcmePay.

james_ops: monitoring: token error rate down, success responses back to baseline 30s after rollback. No CPU/GPU spikes.

incident-bot: Update: PD-INC-8472 status=resolved (automation) at 1766604435 after rollback + traffic shift. Post-incident tasks: (1) ML triage (anya_ml) (2) Improve eval gate thresholds and add multi-suite check (safety + factual) (3) Run canary longer for next rollout.

ryan_oncall: adding postmortem skeleton to #postmortems and assigning owners. Quick notes: Pager fired properly, on-call acked, mitigation via rollback completed, customers notified draft approved by oliver_csm.

anya_ml: i'll own root cause + remediation. Early hypothesis: subtle tokenization boundary change in v3 causing prompted contexts to truncate in rare finance prompts. Will run targeted tests and schedule a deep-dive.

liz_support: i'll follow up with customers and close zendesk after they confirm baseline restored.

ryan_oncall: closing thread here, will link to incident doc once postmortem is up :slightly_smiling_face:
